out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Back handsink paper towels dispenser is not working properly
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM provide paper towels

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: The sanitizer dispenser is dispensing sanitizer at too high a concentration, requiring employees to dilute it manually
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. The sanitizer dispenser needs to be calibrated. In the meantime, employees will continue diluting the sanitizer to a concentration of 150–400 ppm

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Sliced provolone cheese, chicken, tuna, sliced turkey in unit # 1 at 45, 46, 46, 50F, Tuna, sliced ham, sliced tomato, beef in unit # 3 at 48, 48, 50, 50 F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Sliced provolone cheese, chicken, tuna, sliced turkey from unit # 1, Tuna, sliced ham, sliced tomato, beef from unit # 3
